label: Zadok

text.BHSA 1CH 12:27: וִיהֹויָדָ֖ע הַנָּגִ֣יד לְאַהֲרֹ֑ן וְעִמֹּ֕ו שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֹֽות׃ ס
text.KJV 1CH 12:27: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
text.BHSA 1CH 12:28: וְצָדֹ֥וק נַ֖עַר גִּבֹּ֣ור חָ֑יִל וּבֵית־אָבִ֥יו שָׂרִ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס
text.KJV 1CH 12:28: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.
text.BHSA 1CH 12:29: וּמִן־בְּנֵ֧י בִנְיָמִ֛ן אֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְעַד־הֵ֨נָּה֙ מַרְבִּיתָ֔ם שֹׁמְרִ֕ים מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בֵּ֥ית שָׁאֽוּל׃ ס
text.KJV 1CH 12:29: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.

A.name: Zadok
A.line: son of Ahitub and priest during King David's reign (2SA 8:17), a mighty of valor (1CH 12:28)
family: son-of ahitub-2 (Ahitub, (grand) father of Zadok the priest (2SA 8:17, 1CH 9:11), son)
father-of ahimaaz-2 (Ahimaaz, son of Zadok the priest (2SA 15:27))
priest-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)

B.name: Zadok
B.line: Valiant young Benjamite warrior who joined David at Hebron; possibly identical to 1

why: Zadok appears immediately after Jehoiada and the Aaronites; verse 29 then introduces a separate group with וּמִן־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן, “and from the sons of Benjamin.” This placement supports A’s Aaronic lineage rather than B’s stated Benjamite identity.
